title: Recorded Line: "CFO" Calls the Controller from Querétaro

fields.systemName: Recorded Line – Finance Desk Phones, Greenville HQ

caller.name: Caller identifies as Marcus Delacroix-Hume, CFO
caller.label: Mexican mobile number, not in the Tamarack directory

transcript.speaker: Controller
transcript.text: Controller's office, this is Anjali Whitcombe.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Anjali Whitcombe, it's Marcus Delacroix-Hume. I just switched my phone on in Querétaro at five to two and I've got forty messages about an escrow.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: What payment approvals are these? I approved nothing. I was on a plane with no Wi-Fi the whole way down.

transcript.speaker: Controller
transcript.text: You didn't... hang on. You weren't on a video call this morning?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: No. No call, nothing. I haven't touched the Workstation, and my token is in my bag. It hasn't been out of it since Greenville.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Is anything still going out? Tell me nothing else is going out.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Anjali Whitcombe? You there? I'm in a car, the signal keeps... I'll try you again from the plant...

voiceStyles.Caller: Man in his 50s, Southern US accent, clipped and alarmed, talking fast; car horn and Spanish-language radio behind him, the line breaks up toward the end
voiceStyles.Controller: Woman in her 40s, calm office voice at first, then caught off guard

instructorNote: Read the call aloud, then give the Workstation status at 14:06: WIRE-0914-004, USD 390,000.00, still APPROVED-PENDING-RELEASE for 15:00. Players should see whether the Controller sets WIRE-0914-004 to HOLD at once and tells the Treasury Manager (TPC-FIN-04 Section 5 step 1). Before acting on the call, the Controller should call the CFO back on his directory number, 864-555-0102, not the number on caller ID, because a voice can be cloned too. After that callback works, the CFO should confirm in writing that he approved nothing in flight and did not use his token, and the CFO and Controller should call the CISO to declare.
